syntactic_simplification: Mice are central to neuroscience research. They provide a flexible model for scientists. Researchers can control mice to study the brain's workings. Historically, researchers preferred male mice in experiments. This is partly due to concerns about female hormones. Female hormones can cause behavioral variation. This variation might affect results.
lexical_simplification: Mice are important in brain research. They are a flexible model for scientists. Researchers can control mice to study how the brain works. In the past, researchers chose male mice for experiments. This is partly because of worries about female hormones. Female hormones can cause changes in behavior. These changes might affect results.

source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are important in studying the brain. They are easy for scientists to work with. Researchers can manage mice to learn how the brain functions.
